propositions: Three near-identical walkers discover a ticket's replacement link by iterating duplicates then calling find_inbound_relationships for supersedes, differing only in liveness check and return type

Bug frolicky-dependable-peccary arose because verdict() consulted only find_replacement while the not_a_bug exemption rule lived in a comment elsewhere, and DISPOSITION_CLASSES equality with _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES was held only by test

The three walkers apply different class/type filtering: find_replacement guards on DISPOSITION_CLASSES only, _has_live_replacement_link additionally narrows non-bugs to ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES, and _recorded_replacement_target has no class guard and continues to inbound scan on subject reduce failure

Consolidation must preserve the reduce-failure divergence explicitly: live-mode callers (find_replacement, _has_live_replacement_link) return early on subject reduce, while _recorded_replacement_target continues to inbound
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must become an alias of close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES so the two cannot drift apart

The replacement-link walk (find_inbound_relationships in conjunction with supersedes) must appear only once in src/rebar, guarded by a construct-uniqueness test with # replacement-walk-ok escape marker
